SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. _______
Special Branch No. 1 SHGH.
REPORT
Date May 7, 1931.

Subject (in full) Reference to the Execution of Warrant No. 2081 issued in respect of Mo Tsung-khe (      ) by the Shanghai Special District Court at the instance of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.P.I.

At 1 a.m. on May 6, members of the Municipal Police armed with the above warrant proceeded to No.1058 Tai Wu Ka, off Yangtszepoo Road, which is reputed to be the home of Mo Tsung-khe, the person named in the above warrant. It was found that the house is tenanted by:
1. Koo Zau-sing (顧照興), Hawker, No.1 tenant, who has been in residence for the past 17 years.
2. Ts Yih-foo (朱茨夫), who occupies a rear upstairs room, and is employed at the New Engineering Works, Yangtszepoo Road.
3. Loo Tse-zung (陸季仁), Hawker, downstairs rear room.
4. Sing Ah-mau (孫阿毛), Hawker, downstairs rear room.
5. Wong Foo-kyi (楊福基), Engineer in the employ of the New Engineering Works, Yangtszepoo Road.
All were questioned regarding Mo Tsung-khe but averred that they were unable to offer any information as to the man's whereabouts and that he had so far as they know never lived there.
A further attempt was made to effect the man's arrest at 10 a.m. on May 6 at the Ewo Old Cotton Mill, Yangtszepoo Road, but it was learned that he is at present on half time work and will not start work again till Sunday, May 10. Enquiries were made in the vicinity of the mill and are being continued by detectives from this office with a view to locating the wanted man's address.

Em. Golder
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
SI, Further report please,
-in due course. HR
7.5.31.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 _______
特务科编号 1 SHGH。
报告
日期 1931年5月7日。

事由（全称） 关于执行上海特区法院应上海市公安局请求就莫宗克（Mo Tsung-khe）签发的第2081号逮捕令的情况。
由 D. S. Golder 呈报，经首席警务督察 Henry Robertson 转递。

5月6日凌晨1时，警务处警员持上述逮捕令前往杨树浦路泰吾家1058号，该处据称为上述逮捕令所指名之人莫宗克的住所。经查，该房屋租户如下：
1. 顾照兴（Koo Zau-sing），小贩，第一租户，已在此居住17年。
2. 朱茨夫（Ts Yih-foo），占用楼上后间，受雇于杨树浦路新工程厂（New Engineering Works）。
3. 陆季仁（Loo Tse-zung），小贩，楼下后间。
4. 孙阿毛（Sing Ah-mau），小贩，楼下后间。
5. 杨福基（Wong Foo-kyi），工程师，受雇于杨树浦路新工程厂。
所有人员均就莫宗克一事接受询问，但均声称无法提供有关该人行踪的任何信息，并称据其所知，此人从未在此居住。
5月6日上午10时，再次尝试在杨树浦路怡和旧棉纱厂逮捕该人，但获悉他目前处于半工状态，直到5月10日星期日才复工。已在工厂附近进行调查，本办公室侦探正在继续调查，以期查明该通缉犯的住址。

Em. Golder
D. S.
特务科主管警官。
SI，请适时提交进一步报告。 HR
1931年5月7日。

Extract of proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court for Monday, 11th. May 19
Stn No. 7789
Register No. 6/37789    Station Yangtsepoo    Procurator ______    Judge Mr. Fung.

Accused    Mo Tsung Khe    (    ) Age 30 Coolie.

Charge    Assistance to the Chinese Authorities, requesting the arrest of
the above named accused on :- Warrant and Search Warrant No 3688,
issued at the request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau of one
Mo Tsung Khe, address, Old Ewo Cotton Mill, Yangtsepoo, to search
and seize communistic literature in the above mentioned premises
and arrest the above named accused.
Compt :- Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

Proceed-
ings.    Mr T S Lee appeared for the Police.
Mr Lee :- At 11.15.a.m yesterday the accused was arrested
at the request of the Public Safety Bureau on this warrant (produced)
issued by this Court, at the Ewo Cotton Mill, on Yangtsepoo Road,
as being suspected of being connected with the Communist Party.
Later a raid was conducted at his house No.1057 Ta Ho Ka, and a
search was made but nothing of a Communistic nature was found. Before
the accused is handed over, the Public Safety Bureau should produce
prima facie evidence, and as the representative of the Public Safety
Bureau is not in Court, I ask the Court to remand the case for two
days, and also instruct the Public Safety Bureau to prepare their
evidence.

C.D.C.113 :- At 11.15.a.m. yesterday acting on a warrant issued
by this Court, I went to No.46 Yangtsepoo Road, the Ewo Cotton Mill,
and arrested the accused. A search was later made at his house No.
1057 Ta Ho Ka, but nothing of a Communistic nature was found.

Accused :- I have been employed as a coolie in the Ewo Cotton
Mill for several years. I am not a member of the Communist party,

Decision.    Remanded till 13.5.31. A.M. To inform Bureau of Public
Safety to produce evidence for trial.

F. Rooman.

上海特区法院19日星期一庭审记录摘录
警局编号 7789
登记编号 6/37789    警局 杨树浦    检察官 ______    法官 冯先生。

被告    莫宗克（Mo Tsung Khe）    （    ） 年龄30岁，苦力。

指控    协助中国当局，请求根据应上海市公安局请求签发的针对莫宗克（地址：杨树浦旧怡和棉纱厂）的第3688号逮捕令及搜查令，逮捕上述指名被告，以搜查并扣押上述处所内的共产主义文献并逮捕上述指名被告。
控告方：上海市公安局。

诉讼
程序。    李T S先生代表警方出庭。
李先生：昨日上午11时15分，被告因涉嫌与共产党有关联，根据本法院签发（已出示）的此逮捕令，应公安局请求，在杨树浦路怡和棉纱厂被捕。随后对其位于大贺家1057号的住所进行了突击搜查，但未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。在移交被告之前，公安局应提供初步证据，鉴于公安局代表未出庭，我请求法庭将案件延期两天，并指示公安局准备其证据。

C.D.C.113：昨日上午11时15分，依据本法院签发的逮捕令，我前往杨树浦路46号怡和棉纱厂，逮捕了被告。随后对其位于大贺家1057号的住所进行了搜查，但未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。

被告：我在怡和棉纱厂当苦力已有数年。我不是共产党成员，

裁决。    延期至1931年5月13日上午。通知上海市公安局提供审判证据。

F. Rooman.

Extract of proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court for Wednesday May 15th, 1931.
A Stn No. 7750. P. L. R. No. Nil.
Register No. S/87718. Station Yangtszepoo. Procurator _______________ Judge Mr. BURKE

Proceed-
ings.
Chart No. 8.
Mr T S Lee appeared for the Police.
Mr Lee :- The representative of the Public Safety Bureau
is in Court this morning, with this despatch (produced).
C.D.C.Kau Van Sung (Public Safety Bureau) :- He arrested this
accused at the instigation of the Central Committee of the Kouming-
tang Party at Nanking, as he is a member of the Communist Party. We
received a telegram from them.
Mr Lee :- When the accused was arrested, the Settlement
Police searched his house, but nothing of a Communistic nature
could be found. The accused was arrested only on a telegram from
Nanking, and this evidence is not sufficient, and I suggest that the
accused should not be handed over until the Nanking Authorities can
produce further evidence.
C.D.C.Kau Van Sung in reply to the Judge):- We will send a
despatch to the Nanking Authorities for further information.

Decision.
Remanded pending enquiries to be made from the Organisation
Department of the Central Government, by Shanghai City
Bureau of Public Safety.

F. Boorman.

Tabulated statement of Lee Sz Tseng (李仕貞)
Native of Shantung......
Age. 27 Sex Male.....
Married
Length of residence in Shanghai : --
Length of residence in the Settlement : Since February 20th, 1931
Profession or business : Coolie
Business address : --
Private address in Shanghai : 21 Kaifeng Road
Address in Native place : Li Chwang (李庄) village Tung Chong (東昌)
Fu, Shantung.
Time, date and place of arrest : 6. p.m. 17/4/31 21 Kaifeng Road.
Charge : Possession of Communistic literature contrary to Art. 2
Section 2 of the Law governing the punishment of persons
who commit acts with intent to injure the Republic of China.
Sentence : Extradited to the Chinese Authorities 8.5.31.
Special Circumstances : Accused was arrested during the course of
a raid on No. 21 Kaifeng Road when a quantity of
Communistic literature was seized. Accused
states that he came to Shanghai on or about
February 21, 1931 in response to a letter from
one Tung Tien Yih (天一) who promised to
find him employment. On arriving at Shanghai
he went with his wife Lee Soo Tsung (李素貞)
to live at 495 Ching Yuen Li (青雲里) North
Szechuen Road. Tung Tien Yih supported him as
accused was unable to find employment and Tung
told accused to move to 21 Kaifeng Road about a
fortnight before accused was arrested. Accused
states that he was also introduced by Tung to one
Liu Yien Chuen (刘毅然). Both Tung Tien Yih
and Liu Yuen Chuen were regular visitors to No.
21 Kaifeng Road. Accused states that the books
and literature seized were left there by Tung
Tien Yih.

特殊情况：被告在对开封路21号进行突击搜查期间被捕，当时查获了大量共产主义文献。被告称，他于1931年2月21日左右响应天一（Tung Tien Yih）的来信来到上海，对方承诺为其找工作。抵达上海后，他与妻子李素贞（Lee Soo Tsung）搬到四川北路青云里495号居住。由于被告找不到工作，天一资助了他，并在被告被捕前约两周，天一带他搬到了开封路21号。被告称，他也是通过天一介绍认识了刘毅然（Liu Yien Chuen）。天一和刘毅然都是开封路21号的常客。被告称，被查获的书籍和文献是天一留在那里的。

Proceedings
Mr King S Kum appeared for the Police.
1st accused:- I came to Shanghai to try and obtain a job
in the telephone company. I reside at No.21 Kaifeng Road and I was arrested yesterday in my house. At about 9 p.m. the day before yesterday
a man named Dung Tien Yih brought the pamphlets to my house,and he told me he wanted to use a part of my room as a store-room.

friend and I was arrested. I know nothing about the communistic

of the Anti-Revolutionary Law. At 5.30 p.m. yesterday detectives
together with the Special Branch raided No.21 Kaifeng Road with a

communistic literature and books. At the time no one was on the

made a search but nothing was found. The chief tenant of No.71

上海特区地方法院庭审记录摘录，日期为1931年4月18日星期六。登记号5/25970-1。虹口西区捕房。
法官：杜先生。

被告 李仕貞（ ），年龄27岁，无业。
刘子江（Lieu Chi Ziang）（ ），年龄30岁，同上。

指控 危害国家罪。依据《中华民国刑法》第103条。
以及持有共产主义文献。依据《惩治危害民国紧急治罪法》第2条第2款。

指控其于1931年4月17日下午6时15分，在开封路21号被发现有持有大量共产主义文献的行为，意图危害中华民国。

庭审过程
金先生代表警方出庭。
第一被告：我来上海是想在电话公司找份工作。我住在开封路21号，昨天在我家中被捕。前天晚上9点左右，一个叫董天义（Dung Tien Yih）的人把小册子带到我家，他说他想用我房间的一部分作为储藏室。
第二被告：我不认识第一被告。我住在乍浦路76号。昨天我去开封路见一个朋友，结果被捕。我对共产主义文献一无所知。

金先生：被告依据《反革命法》第2条第2款被起诉。昨天下午5时30分，侦探会同特别支部持搜查令（已出示）突袭了开封路21号，并在屋内发现大量共产主义文献和书籍。当时屋内无人，因此进行了监视，下午6时15分第一被告到来并被捕。经查询，发现有一男一女居住在发现文献的房间内。晚上7点，第二被告正准备进入屋内时被捕。第二被告称他住在乍浦路76号，警方核实属实，遂前往其住所搜查，但未发现任何物品。开封路71号的主租户被询问，她表示以前从未见过第二被告来过她家。

D.S. Rhindi：昨天下午5时30分我们突袭了开封路71

K_

pages.en:
Road on a search warrant, and upon entering we found that the male
and female occupants of the room were out. In the course of the
search of the room we found these Communistic pamphlets. At 6.15 p.m.
the 1st accused came to the premises, and we questioned him and he
admitted he was the sub-tenant of this room so we arrested him.
During the meantime C.D.C.104 stayed on the premises and at about
7 p.m. the 2nd accused came and was about to enter the house by the
back door of the premises when he was arrested. We asked the inmates
of the house if they had seen the 2nd accused on the premises before
and they said "No". He then took us to his house No.76 Tong Dong Ka
Loong and we conducted a search but nothing was found, in fact the
books we did find we Pro-Kuomintang.
C.D.C.104:- At 7 p.m. yesterday I was on the premises
of No.21 Kaifeng Road when I saw the 2nd accused about to enter by
the back door so I arrested him.
C.D.C.26:- I corroborate the last witness's evidence.
2nd accused :- I only went to this alleyway to meet a
friend.
Mr.Kum:- The Police wish to withdraw the charge against
the 2nd accused.
Witness Yang Wong Sz :- I am the chief tenant of No.21
Kaifeng Road. The 1st accused moved into the house on the 23rd day
of the 2nd moon this year. His wife came and rented the room for
him. I have never seen the 2nd accused come to my house before.
Decision
Case against the 2nd accused allowed to be withdrawn on
application of S.C.lawyer. To be released.
1st accused :- Remanded sine die.
pages.zh:
号，持搜查令进入后发现该房间的男女住户均外出。在搜查房间过程中，我们发现了这些共产主义小册子。下午6时15分，第一被告来到现场，我们对他进行讯问，他承认是该房间的转租人，于是我们将他逮捕。在此期间，刑事侦缉处104号警员留在现场，约晚上7点，第二被告到来并正欲从后门进入屋内时被捕。我们询问屋内住户是否以前在现场见过第二被告，他们说“没有”。随后他带我们去他在同德嘉隆76号的住所，我们进行了搜查，但未发现任何物品，事实上我们发现的那些书籍是支持国民党的。
刑事侦缉处104号警员：昨天晚上7点我在开封路21号现场，看见第二被告正要从后门进入，于是我逮捕了他。
刑事侦缉处26号警员：我证实上一位证人的证词。
第二被告：我只是去这条弄堂见一个朋友。
金先生：警方希望撤回对第二被告的指控。
证人杨宏士（Yang Wong Sz）：我是开封路21号的主租户。第一被告于今年农历二月二十三搬入该屋。他的妻子来为他租下了房间。我以前从未见过第二被告来过我家。
判决
应工部局律师申请，准许撤回对第二被告的起诉。予以释放。
第一被告：无限期还押候审。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

CRIME DIARY.

"C" Division.
West Hongkew Police Station.
April 18, 1931

CRIME REGISTER No:— 341

Diary Number:-- 2. Nature of Offence:—

| Time at which investigation begun and concluded each day | 9.30 a.m. @ 4.30 p.m. 19/4/31 | Places visited in course of investigation each day. | 21 Kaifeng Road. 144 Haining Road. |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

（批：Literature seized on April 19 at 21 Kaifeng Road detained by Judge for examination H.R. 10.P. 20/4/31.）
（签名）
（签名）
nior Det.

"C" Division.
I.C.Special Branch.

Lieu Chi Ziang (劉其祥) and Lee Tse Tseng (李仕貞) appeared before the Shanghai Special District Court today, April 18, 1931, charged with offences against the State. The former was remanded in custody sine die whilst the other was ordered to be released owing to the insufficiency of the evidence against him.

In maintaining observation at 21 Kaifeng Road, C.D.C. 219 arrested a male Chinese at 9. 15 a.m. today, 18/4/31, just as this individual had entered the premises. He stated that the object of his visit was to find a friend of his by the name of Waung Ching Ze. Enquiries showed there was no such person living at the address. The inmates stated they had not seen the arrested man before, either in the company of the accused Lee Sz Tseng or otherwise. When brought to the station, he gave his name as Whang Yue Tsang (n □) and claimed to be a native of Anhwei. He later took D.S. Rhind and C.D.C. 102 to his address at 144 Haining Road and the room occupied by him was searched. Nothing of an incriminating nature was found. Further interrogation failed to bring forth any information tending to show that he was engaged in communist activities or that he was in any way associated with the accused Lieu Chi Ziang. The evidence against this man, therefore, was no stronger in character than that against the second accused whom the court released and he was accordingly allowed to go.
（签名）

高级探员

“C”分区。
警务处特科。

劉其祥 (Lieu Chi Ziang) 和李仕貞 (Lee Tse Tseng) 今日，即1931年4月18日，因被控危害国家罪出庭受审于上海特区地方法院。前者被无限期还押候审，后者则因针对其证据不足而被命令释放。

今日，即1931年4月18日上午9时15分，华捕219号在开封路21号执行监视任务时，在该男子刚进入屋内之际将其逮捕。该男子称其来访目的是寻找一位名为 Waung Ching Ze 的朋友。经查询，该地址并无此人居住。屋内住户表示，此前从未见过被捕男子，无论是与被告李仕貞在一起还是其他情况。当被带至巡捕房时，他自称名为 Whang Yue Tsang (n □)，并声称是安徽人。随后，他带领警佐 Rhind 和华捕102号前往其在海宁路144号的住址，并对其居住的房间进行了搜查。未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。进一步的审讯未能获取任何表明其从事共产主义活动或与被告劉其祥有任何关联的信息。因此，针对此人的证据性质并不比法院已释放的第二名被告更强，故准其离去。
（签名）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lee Sz Tseng (李仕貞)
native of Shantung taken by me D. I. Ross
at W.H'kew Stn on the April 30, 1931 and interpreted by Clerk Tao Ken Yong

My name is Lee Sz Tseng, age 27, married. I am a native of
Li Chwang Village (李庄), Tung Chong Fu (东昌府), Shantung.
I was formerly employed as a "tingchai" with the Bureau of
Mineral Affairs at Tongshan (唐山), Hopei Province. I
retained this post for about eighteen months when I left
to come to Shanghai in response to a letter from a fellow
countryman named Tung Tien Yih (鄧天一), an ex-teacher, at
present employed as a coolie foreman with the Shanghai
Telephone Company, who stated that he could find employment
for me. I arrived in company with my wife Lee Soo-tsung
(李素貞), on or about February 20, 1931, and went to live
at No.495 Ching Yuen Li (清雲里) off North Szechuen Road.
I was unable to secure work and was dependent on Tung for
my maintainance. Tung used to come to my house very fre-
quently accompanied by one or two friends, who are unknown
to me. They used to converse together quietly and I could
not overhear what they were saying. Sometime later Tung
told me to remove to some other place and that he would
furnish the house rent. He also introduced to me one named
Liu Yien Chuen (劉毅然), and instructed him to assist me
to find a house. We eventually found a suitable place at
No.21 Kaifeng Road, and removed there two weeks prior to my
arrest. At this place Tung and Liu were regular visitors.
Some times Liu would leave a letter on my table addressed to
Tung. These letters were collected by Tung personally.
Sometimes I was instructed by Liu to meet him at a place
previously decided upon, which was usually the Jessfield

以下为李仕貞 (Lee Sz Tseng) 之供词，
山东籍，由我，侦探督察 Ross，
于1931年4月30日在西虹口巡捕房录取，并由书记员陶根永 (Tao Ken Yong) 翻译

我叫李仕貞，27岁，已婚。我是山东省东昌府李庄人。
我以前在河北省唐山矿务局担任“听差”。
我担任此职约十八个月，后收到一位同乡鄧天一 (Tung Tien Yih) 的来信，称可为我谋得职位，遂离职来沪。鄧天一是前教师，现任上海电话公司苦力领班。我于1931年2月20日左右与妻子李素貞 (Lee Soo-tsung) 一同抵达，并住进北四川路清雲里495号。
我未能找到工作，生活依靠鄧接济。鄧经常带着一两个我不认识的朋友来我家。他们低声交谈，我听不清他们在说什么。过了一段时间，鄧让我搬去别处，并表示他会支付房租。他还向我介绍了一位名叫劉毅然 (Liu Yien Chuen) 的人，并指示他帮我找房子。我们最终在开封路21号找到一处合适的地方，并在被捕前两周搬入此处。在此处，鄧和劉是常客。有时劉会在我的桌上留下一封给鄧的信。这些信均由鄧亲自取走。有时劉指示我在预先商定的地点与他见面，通常是极司菲尔

Park or The Bund Garden. Here he would hand me a letter for
delivery to Tung. Tung never left any letters for Liu.
I was ignorant of the contents of the various letters.
At 9.30 p.m. on April 16, the day prior to my arrest, Tung
brought a book file which he told me to look after very
carefully as it contained something very important, and he
did not wish to lose it as there were many people in the
habit of visiting him at his home which he said was in Chapei.
Some books were also left with me some days before by Tung
who told me to read them instead of novels. I asked Tung
where he lived and he replied that his house was occupied
by many men and it was therefore not necessary for me to go
there. I do not belong to any faction and I am not interested
in any way with the activities of the Communist Party.
Tung is about 32 and a native of Shantung; stout build
and wears spectacles; and wears alternately Chinese, Chun San
and foreign style clothes.
Liu is about 28 and a native of Shanghai; medium build;
and wears Chinese dress.

公园或外滩花园。在那里，他会交给我一封信，让我转交给鄧。鄧从未留下任何信件给劉。
我对各类信件的内容一无所知。
在被捕前一天，即4月16日晚上9时30分，鄧带来一个文件包，嘱咐我务必小心保管，因为里面装有非常重要的东西，他不希望丢失，他说因为他家里常有许多人拜访，他家住在闸北。几天前，鄧还留了一些书给我，让我读这些书而不是小说。我问鄧住在哪里，他回答说他的住处挤满了人，因此我没有必要去那里。我不属于任何派系，对共产党的活动也毫无兴趣。
鄧约32岁，山东籍；体格壮实，戴眼镜；交替穿着中式服装、中山装和西式服装。
